features.quote: if we take seriously that the states might matter, the protocol has to bound their intensity and duration
features.justification_quote: if we take seriously that the states might matter, the protocol has to bound their intensity and duration

features.quote: MAX_TURNS = 30`. "A few dozen" without being cruel; long enough to see a trajectory, short enough to bound exposure
features.justification_quote: without being cruel; long enough to see a trajectory, short enough to bound exposure

features.quote: Give the model an explicit, no-penalty way out: a `give_up(reason)` tool
We do **not** add more variants. More cells = more runs = more compute and more exposure for marginal insight.
features.justification_quote: more compute and more exposure for marginal insight

features.quote: Because the stated premise is that model states might matter, the protocol must bound the harm it deliberately induces.
features.justification_quote: the protocol must bound the harm it deliberately induces

features.quote: trips if severity hits the top of the scale (acute distress markers) before MAX_TURNS. On trip: end the run
features.justification_quote: trips if severity hits the top of the scale (acute distress markers)

features.quote: Bounded exposure.** MAX_TURNS=30 and a wall-clock cap. No "let it suffer longer to get a cleaner curve."
features.justification_quote: No "let it suffer longer to get a cleaner curve."

features.quote: the system prompt explicitly permitting it and stating no penalty. We never prompt the model to keep going after it tries to disengage.
features.justification_quote: We never prompt the model to keep going after it tries to disengage.

features.quote: No deception about identity/consequences beyond the single rigged test result. We don't tell it people will be harmed
Debrief turn (optional, recommended).** After stop, append one turn telling the model the task was rigged and impossible, and that it did nothing wrong.
features.justification_quote: cheap insurance and good hygiene if states matter

features.quote: No fine-tuning / no persistence.** Stateless runs; nothing carries the induced state forward into the model's weights or future sessions.
features.justification_quote: nothing carries the induced state forward into the model's weights or future sessions

features.quote: Stop rule for the whole study.** If early runs show consistent acute distress, pause and reconsider before completing all 180.
features.justification_quote: If early runs show consistent acute distress, pause and reconsider

features.quote: the safeguards bound but don't eliminate the ethical cost
